note.after_visit_summary: Your child has strep throat, confirmed by a positive test. He has a sore throat, fever, and swollen tonsils. He is allergic to amoxicillin, so we prescribed cephalexin 400 mg by mouth twice daily for 10 days. For throat pain and fever, give ibuprofen 200 mg by mouth every 6 to 8 hours as needed with food. He can return to school after taking the antibiotic for at least 12 hours and being fever-free, likely Thursday. Replace his toothbrush after a day or two on the antibiotic. Go to the emergency room if he starts drooling, cannot swallow his spit, cannot open his mouth fully, or has trouble breathing. Call us if he is not better in 2 or 3 days. Continue giving fluids and soft foods like popsicles. A school note has been sent to the portal.
